summary: Shared change (client UI flow plus how a play's player choice is submitted). Table clicks, phase 1 (hand cards). A hand card whose action still needs a performer, target or payment goes straight to choosing them on the table; 'Confirm play' remains only for an action with nothing left to choose (its final Confirm). The card's other actions stay a 'Play instead' row away in every draft. PlayKey no longer collapses sibling plays: 'choose a player', deck position, created card, compare and shown card are distinct plays, so 'your opponent' submits the opponent instead of silently the first listed player. A card that names 'another player' decides it itself. Client only; no Core change.
validation: Native: tools/check-direct-play-ui.sh passes with new steps; check-card-deselection, check-multi-targets-ui, check-attack-targets-ui, check-province-target-ui pass; check.sh --client-only builds and smoke-runs; whitespace format verified. tools/check-support-cards.sh fails identically on unmodified origin/main (Projected Region inspection), so it is not caused by this change.
remaining: Phases 2 to 10 of the table-click plan (artifacts/table-click-audit/IMPLEMENTATION_PROMPT.md). The player pick for 'choose a player' abilities is still the action rows until phase 5.
